Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.gwc

Class GwcLayer

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.gwc.GwcLayer
public class GwcLayer extends Object
DTO for a GWC tile layer (GeoServerLayer). Used for both GET and PUT.

Some fields (id, inMemoryCached, cacheWarningSkips) are returned by GET but ignored on PUT (WRITE_ONLY annotation prevents serialization).

parameterFilters is populated on GET. GWC returns these as polymorphic XML elements (styleParameterFilter, regexParameterFilter, etc.) that are difficult to round-trip on PUT — see GwcLayerManager upsert for the recommended approach.

PUT must use application/xml — JSON PUT on GeoServer 2.28.2 causes an XStream "Duplicate field" 500 error (see GwcLayerManager).
